references.title: How Meta ranks Facebook and Instagram content

answer:
Based on the analysis of the Facebook profile "joanquizonmakeup," here are three concrete next actions:

1. **Develop "Behind-the-Scenes" Educational Content**: The post addressing what makeup artists do on weekdays achieved the highest engagement with 89 likes [P5]. I propose experimenting with a series of "Day in the Life" posts to see if educational transparency continues to drive higher engagement than standard portfolio photos.

2. **Optimize for High-Share Storytelling**: There is a strong correlation between likes and shares (0.783) [Facts], with the Tuscany wedding post achieving the most shares (11) [P4]. I propose testing more narrative-driven captions focused on destination weddings to determine if storytelling increases the share rate compared to short descriptive captions.

3. **Implement Engagement-Driven AI Ranking Strategy**: Meta utilizes AI systems to rank content based on user choices to ensure relevance [W1]. Since the account has a 0% request rate from comments [Demand], I propose experimenting with direct call-to-action questions in captions to increase meaningful interactions, which may signal relevance to the AI and improve Feed visibility [W1].
